gaps.note: Wrong as stated. The primes are chosen with (1-2eta)t_i < s_i <= (1-eta)t_i, so the relative distance (t_i-s_i)/t_i lies in [eta, 2eta), not equal to eta. Eta is only a lower bound on the relative distance (and 2eta an upper bound); paper lines 4092 and 4135 define eta=1/(4d) only as the parameter of the prime interval.
